prompt: Create one finished raster inventory icon for a dark fantasy RPG potion called Chaotic Essence (no written title). Square composition, designed to remain clearly legible when reduced to 60 by 60 pixels. Single squat faceted glass potion bottle, pale ivory cork at upper left, three-quarter angle tilted slightly right. Inside: a bright swirling violet-and-cyan magical liquid with a small contrasting pink spark at its center, visibly turbulent but readable, no floating particles outside the icon. Hand-painted old fantasy game item illustration, restrained highlights, subtle glass texture, clear silhouette. Surround it with one slim weathered bronze/gold square frame, rounded bevel corners, dark charcoal-brown interior; the frame and dark interior fit almost the whole square, very similar to classic parchment-and-brass RPG button icons. Outer area outside rounded corners genuinely transparent. Bottle occupies about 75 percent of interior. No text, letters, numbers, watermarks, logos, extra icons or UI, and no surrounding scene. This is a brand new original game asset.
